Callout.Name: Vehicle Stopped on a Bridge
Callout.Message: Vehicle parked on a bridge, driver seen at the rail.

Script.Line: He is parked on the bridge and he is stood at the rail.
He has not done anything. He is just stood there looking at the water.
I am keeping well back. That is why I called you.

Lines.Approach: He is out of the car and he is at the rail. Do not rush this one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
